title: 金属算法对照：只读比较，不重审模型
summary: 只读对照：绿色为候选掩膜；未证明人工提速。S04检查点2/3及第二提示点偏离细线，不计入稀疏汇总；其原结果保留。无需重新裁决旧几何或四个非孔。

scope.note: 四个局部窗口；非全幅验收。

items.title: L01 细线与左短头
items.prompt: 只读比较算法掩膜；不要求重新确认已审几何。

facts.性质: 算法对照，不重新审批既有几何
facts.AI目视检查: All three retain main line and short head; SAM has a broader/smoother edge and small fringe pixels.

evidence.label: AI稀疏检查点：红=目标，青=非目标

items.title: S03 窄线转角
items.prompt: 只读比较算法掩膜；不要求重新确认已审几何。

facts.性质: 算法对照，不重新审批既有几何
facts.AI目视检查: All three retain main line/head; SAM broadens below the head.

evidence.label: AI稀疏检查点：红=目标，青=非目标

items.title: W4 宽金属及邻近细线
items.prompt: 只读比较算法掩膜；不要求重新确认已审几何。

facts.性质: 算法对照，不重新审批既有几何
facts.AI目视检查: GrabCut collapses to tiny fragments; Otsu has stripe holes; SAM is more continuous but has residual holes.

evidence.label: AI稀疏检查点：红=目标，青=非目标

items.title: S04 细支路及左侧宽金属
items.prompt: 只读比较算法掩膜；不要求重新确认已审几何。

facts.性质: 算法对照，不重新审批既有几何
facts.AI目视检查: Otsu and SAM visually retain the fine branch; GrabCut largely retains only the head. Sparse diagnostic and prompt offset invalidate a clean quantitative comparison.

evidence.label: AI稀疏检查点：红=目标，青=非目标

items.title: V1模板匹配：已知正负例回归
items.prompt: 只读：四个非孔保持原裁决；橙框为最高相似位置，不代表孔。

facts.模板: A仅作自匹配检查，不计评估
facts.检查: B一个已知正例 + 四个已判非孔目标
facts.阈值: 0.50四个非孔全部误报；0.65和0.80在本批能分开。非泛化准确率。

limitations: Same chip, selected known regions; exploratory comparison, not blind generalization.
AI sparse probes are not human pixel truth. Native paths locate objects; design widths are not segmentation ground truth.
All segmentation masks remain candidates; no geometry, hole count, carrier or net changes.

Otsu uses positive prompts to select components; GrabCut uses the shared box as hard exclusion and point disks as constraints; SAM uses the same box/point locations as model prompts. Different mechanisms, not identical supervision.
No mask hole filling or geometric completion; no threshold tuning after outputs.
Manual baseline and correction time unmeasured; no end-to-end speedup claim.
Known negative targets used only for regression, not resubmitted for human approval.
